cardEffects:
[When Digivolving] For each Tamer your opponent has in play, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less becomes suspended, you may delete those Digimon.
name: Dinorexmon

rulings.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect gain me 1 memory per each of my opponent's Tamers?

rulings.answer: Yes. You’ll gain 1 memory for each of your opponent’s Tamers.
rulings.question: If my opponent has multiple Tamers but only 1 Digimon in play, do I gain 1 memory for each of my opponent's Tamers even though only 1 Digimon will be suspended?

rulings.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “You may delete that Digimon,” so you can choose not to.  If you choose not to, the effect’s [Once Per Turn] requirement won’t be used up, either.
rulings.question: If my opponent’s Digimon with 6000 DP or less becomes suspended, can I choose NOT to delete it with this card’s [All Turns] effect?

rulings.answer: When your opponent activates ＜Blocker＞, the target of the attack is switched to the Digimon that activated ＜Blocker＞, and that Digimon is then deleted by this Digimon's [All Turns] effect.  Since the Digimon that activated ＜Blocker＞ was deleted, no battle occurs, and the attack ends.
rulings.question: I attack with a Digimon, and my opponent activates ＜Blocker＞ to suspend their Digimon with 6000 DP or less. I then activate this card’s [All Turns] effect to delete that Digimon. What happens to the attack?

rulings.answer: Yes you can, as long as they are simultaneously suspended.
rulings.question: I used an effect like [BT6-103 Blasted Disaster] that suspends multiple DIgimon to simultaneously suspend 2 of my opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.  In such cases, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to delete those 2 Digimon?
Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect get Memory +1 for each opponent's tamer?

rulings.answer: Yes, memory +1 for the number of tamers on the opponent.
rulings.question: When [When Digivolving] effect of this card, if the opponent has multiple tamers and the opponent has only one Digimon, only one Digimon will be rested, but will the number of tamers be Memory +1?

rulings.answer: Yes, it is a "can be" effect, so it does not have to be deleted. In that case, the [Once Per Turn] limit is also not consumed.
rulings.question: Can this card's [All Opponent's Turns] effect intentionally not delete when an opponent's Digimon with DP6000 or less is rested?

rulings.answer: After blocking, the target of the attack is changed to the blocked Digimon because it is deleted by the card's effect. Since the blocked Digimon has been deleted, no battle takes place and the attack is over.
rulings.question: Against my Digimon's attack, an opponent's Digimon with DP6000 or less blocked and rested, so I deleted that opponent's Digimon with this card's [All Your Turns] effect. In this case, what happens to the attack?

rulings.answer: Yes, if you rested at the same time, it is possible.
rulings.question: I have rested two opponent's Digimon with DP6000 or less at the same time by an effect that rests multiple Digimon, such as "BT6-103 Blasted Disaster". In that case, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to delete those two Digimon?

During my opponent's turn, an opponent's Digimon with DP6000 or less attacked and this card's [All Opponent's Turns] effect and my opponent's effect triggered at the same time.
